name: Vessel
gap: A body that can hold a curse
desc: Someone who swallowed what should have killed them. A curse sleeps inside, and the body has grown tough enough to hold it.
traits: Eating a cursed finger or cursed object gives Strength I for 60 s instead of poisoning you
+4 max health and fast natural healing
Below 20% health the curse stirs: Nausea for 3 s (once a minute)

abilities.name: Iron Gut
abilities.text: Eat any cursed or rotten item safely and gain food from it for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Inner Voice
abilities.text: The curse inside points to the nearest special-grade object or boss within 128 blocks for 30 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Superhuman Leap
abilities.text: Jump 6 blocks high and take no fall damage from it. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Swap Out
abilities.text: For 10 s the curse takes over: you can't be stunned or slowed, but you can't use items. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shrug Off
abilities.text: Remove every harmful effect and heal 4. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Divergent Fist
abilities.text: A punch that hits twice: once on contact and a cursed-energy echo 0.5 s later. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Finger Hunger
abilities.text: Sense every cursed finger and cursed object within 64 blocks as markers for 15 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Steel Will
abilities.text: For 20 s you can't be charmed, possessed, blinded or made to flee. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Brute Carry
abilities.text: Pick up and throw a heavy block or a downed ally 6 blocks. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sprint Burst
abilities.text: Speed III for 4 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cursed Digestion
abilities.text: Turn a cursed item in your hand into 20% mana and 4 health. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Flash
abilities.text: Your next hit within 5 s that lands deals 2.5x damage with black sparks. 90 s cooldown.

name: Cursed Spirit
source: Cursed Fate cursed spirits, Mahito, Jogo
desc: Not born but condensed out of human fear. Sorcerers hunt them, ordinary people can't see them, and they don't truly die while the fear remains.
traits: Players without cursed energy (no Cursed Fate technique) can't see you clearly: you're shown faded
Immune to poison and hunger drains 50% slower
Healing from food and potions is halved; you heal by absorbing fear (kills heal 2)

abilities.name: Unseen
abilities.text: Become invisible to mobs and to players without a technique for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Feed on Fear
abilities.text: Villagers and passive mobs within 12 blocks panic; you heal 1 for each one for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reform
abilities.text: When you'd die, reform from your cursed energy at 4 health instead (once every 20 minutes).

abilities.name: Phase Through
abilities.text: Pass through one block-thick walls for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Sense
abilities.text: See every cursed spirit, sorcerer and cursed object within 48 blocks for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Idle Transfiguration Touch
abilities.text: Your next hit within 10 s twists the target: Slowness III and Weakness II for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.text: Villagers and animals avoid you, and hostile mobs below 10 health flee from you for 20 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Womb
abilities.text: Leave a cursed womb that hatches a weak curse ally after 30 s, lasting 2 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lurk in Shadows
abilities.text: Become invisible while standing in light below 7 for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Body Reshape
abilities.text: Shrink to half size for 30 s to fit through small gaps. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.text: Mark a block; you see what happens there for 10 s from any distance in the same world. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Soul Grip
abilities.text: Grab the enemy you look at (6 blocks): it's rooted and takes 2 damage a second for 3 s. 60 s cooldown.

name: Heavenly Restricted
gap: No cursed energy, a perfect body
desc: Born with no cursed energy at all. The universe paid them back in flesh: senses, speed and strength beyond any sorcerer.
traits: +15% movement and attack speed, +2 armour
Can see cursed spirits and invisible creatures within 16 blocks
Can't use Cursed Fate techniques or domains, and mana is capped at 20%

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.text: Every creature within 32 blocks shows through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Inventory Curse
abilities.text: Open a 9-slot pocket that holds weapons (a cursed spirit you carry). 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wall Run
abilities.text: Run along walls for 3 s. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Domain Blind Spot
abilities.text: For 10 s, domain expansions and sure-hit effects can't find you. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hunter's Nose
abilities.text: Track the player or mob you name: a pointer for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.text: Dash 10 blocks forward, hitting the first enemy for your weapon's damage. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cursed Tool Mastery
abilities.text: Cursed tools and weapons deal 20% more for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Silent Step
abilities.text: Your footsteps make no sound and mobs don't hear you for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Iron Body
abilities.text: Immune to poison, hunger and slowness for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Climb
abilities.text: Climb any wall like a ladder for 10 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Weapon Catch
abilities.text: Catch the next arrow or thrown weapon that would hit you within 5 s, keeping it. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Killing Intent
abilities.text: Enemies within 8 blocks are stunned with fear for 1.5 s. 90 s cooldown.

name: Death Painting
source: Choso and the Death Painting wombs
desc: A cursed womb made flesh, half-human and half-curse. Their blood is a weapon and their brothers are everything.
traits: Immune to bleeding and poison
Blood regenerates: heal 1 every 5 s while above half hunger
Fire deals 25% more damage (blood boils)

abilities.name: Blood Sense
abilities.text: Sense every wounded creature (below full health) within 32 blocks for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Coagulate
abilities.text: Stop all bleeding on you and allies within 6, healing each 4. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Flowing Red Scale
abilities.text: Speed I, Strength I and Haste I for 20 s, costing 4 health. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Brother's Bond
abilities.text: Mark one ally: you always know where they are, and you feel it when they're hurt, for 20 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Bridge
abilities.text: Harden your blood into a 6-block bridge ahead that lasts 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Piercing Blood
abilities.text: Fire a compressed blood beam in a line (16 blocks), 8 damage, costing 2 health. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Pact
abilities.text: Give 4 of your health to an ally you look at. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Trail
abilities.text: Leave a blood trail for 60 s that you can follow back. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Supernova
abilities.text: Stop a fall: burst blood under you to land without damage. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Rot Touch
abilities.text: Rot the crop, food or wooden block you touch into bone meal. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Brothers' Rally
abilities.text: Allies within 10 blocks get Regeneration I for 10 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Slicing Exorcism
abilities.text: Two blood blades fly out and cut every enemy in a 6-block arc for 6 damage. 60 s cooldown.

name: Cursed Corpse
desc: A stitched-together body with a cursed core instead of a heart. Some have more than one core, and more than one personality.
traits: Don't need to breathe; immune to poison and hunger effects
+4 max health and +2 armour
Can't eat cooked food for effects: you're fed by cursed energy (eat bones, wool and cursed objects)

abilities.name: Core Swap
abilities.text: Switch between two cores: one gives Speed I, one gives Resistance I. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Stitch Up
abilities.text: Repair yourself with string or wool: heal 6. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Plush Body
abilities.text: Take no fall damage for 30 s and bounce off the ground. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hibernate Core
abilities.text: Stand still to heal 2 a second for 10 s, but you can't move. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Friend
abilities.text: Sew a small cursed corpse that follows you and carries 9 items for 10 minutes. 15 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Drumming Beat
abilities.text: Your next hit within 10 s ignores armour and knocks back hard. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Gorilla Core
abilities.text: For 20 s your hits break blocks like a pickaxe. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Cuddle
abilities.text: Hug an ally: both heal 1 a second for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Patch Armour
abilities.text: Repair your armour by 10% using wool or leather. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Spare Core
abilities.text: Store a spare core; the next death within 30 minutes leaves you at 6 health. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rolling
abilities.text: Curl up and roll 10 blocks forward, immune to knockback. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Bear Slam
abilities.text: Slam the ground: enemies within 3 blocks are knocked down for 1 s. 60 s cooldown.

name: Disaster Spirit
desc: A curse born from humanity's fear of the earth, the forest or the sea. Choose which disaster you embody when you pick the race (fire, forest or ocean); one ability follows it.
traits: Immune to the damage of your element (fire, thorns and poison plants, or drowning)
Your element's biome heals you 1 every 5 s
The opposite element hurts you 25% more (water, fire or lightning)

abilities.name: Elemental Body
abilities.text: Fire: walk on lava. Forest: plants grow under your feet. Ocean: swim like a fish. For 30 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nature's Ear
abilities.text: Feel every creature touching your element within 32 blocks (in fire, in plants, in water) for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Calamity Weather
abilities.text: Fire: clear skies. Forest: rain. Ocean: rain and high waves. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shape the Land
abilities.text: Fire: turn stone to magma. Forest: grow a tree or vines. Ocean: make a water pool. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Disaster Shell
abilities.text: Gain 8 absorption made of your element for 15 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Elemental Burst
abilities.text: Fire: a volcano erupts under the target. Forest: a cursed bud drains it. Ocean: a fish swarm hits it. 8 damage. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Element Walk
abilities.text: Leave a trail of your element (embers, grass or water) for 20 s that speeds you up. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Calamity Sense
abilities.text: Know when a storm, raid or boss spawns within 128 blocks, for 10 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Disaster Shelter
abilities.text: Raise a dome of your element (stone, wood or water) around you for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Feed the Land
abilities.text: Grow, melt or flood a 6-block area to your element's shape. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Elemental Mount
abilities.text: Ride a creature of your element (a magma cube, a wooden beast or a fish) for 60 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Maximum Disaster
abilities.text: A 6-block field of your element for 6 s: burning, choking vines or crushing water. 3 min cooldown.

name: Incarnate
gap: An old soul in a new body
desc: A sorcerer from a thousand years ago, sleeping in a body that once belonged to someone else. They remember techniques no one alive knows.
traits: Gain 25% more experience from killing sorcerers and bosses
Speak the old tongue: read enchantment and spell scrolls without a lectern
Villagers don't trust you: trades cost 15% more

abilities.name: Ancient Memory
abilities.text: Learn: the next spell scroll or skill book you read gives double experience. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Possess
abilities.text: Take control of a weaker mob you look at (below 20 health) for 20 s, seeing through it. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Old Ways
abilities.text: Craft one cursed tool or talisman without a crafting table. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Barrier
abilities.text: Raise a simple barrier (a curtain) around a 10-block area for 60 s: mobs can't see in. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Host's Instinct
abilities.text: For 10 s, see the last 3 places you died or were badly hurt. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Forgotten Technique
abilities.text: Cast a random technique from a past life: a lightning strike, a fire burst or a gravity slam. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Old Sword Style
abilities.text: Swords and spears gain +1 reach for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Contract
abilities.text: Make a deal with a cursed spirit mob: it won't attack you for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Culling Points
abilities.text: Each player-like enemy kill gives a Culling Point; spend 5 to heal fully. Passive with 60 s cooldown on spending.

abilities.name: Heian Lore
abilities.text: Identify the item in your hand: see its full stats and hidden effects. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Body Hop
abilities.text: Swap your health with a tame animal's you look at. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reversed Cursed Technique
abilities.text: Heal 10 health over 2 s. 3 min cooldown.

name: Six Eyes Heir
desc: Born with the Six Eyes, which see cursed energy to the atom. Their techniques waste almost nothing, but the eyes tire quickly.
traits: Spells cost 10% less mana
See invisible creatures and cursed energy (all spells' projectiles glow)
Bright light gives Blindness for 1 s every 30 s unless you wear a blindfold or helmet

abilities.name: Blindfold
abilities.text: Put the blindfold on: lose the light penalty and see every living thing within 24 blocks through walls for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Efficient Flow
abilities.text: Your next 3 spells cost no mana. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Read the Technique
abilities.text: Look at a mob or player: learn its health, armour and what it's weak to. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Infinity Step
abilities.text: Teleport to the block you look at (12 blocks). 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Float
abilities.text: Hover in place for 6 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lapse: Blue
abilities.text: Pull every enemy within 8 blocks of the spot you look at into its centre. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Insight
abilities.text: See every hidden block (traps, chests, spawners) within 16 blocks for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Infinity
abilities.text: For 3 s, nothing can touch you: attacks and projectiles stop just short. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Spell Echo
abilities.text: Repeat the last spell you cast at half power, free. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Mana Sight
abilities.text: See every player and mob's mana and spell cooldowns within 24 blocks for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Detached
abilities.text: Ignore gravity for 4 s and walk on air. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reversal: Red
abilities.text: Push every enemy within 6 blocks away hard. 60 s cooldown.

name: Shadow Clan Heir
source: Megumi Fushiguro, the Zen'in Ten Shadows
desc: Heir to a technique that draws shikigami from shadow. They start with dogs and frogs, and some never find out what the tenth shadow is.
traits: Shadows are pockets: 9 extra storage slots while in light below 8
Dogs and wolves are friendly
Must have both hands free (no shield) to summon

abilities.name: Divine Dogs
abilities.text: Summon two shadow dogs that track and fight for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Toad
abilities.text: Summon a toad that pulls you or an item to safety with its tongue. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nue
abilities.text: Summon a great owl that carries you through the air for 8 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Sink
abilities.text: Sink into your own shadow and move through the ground for 5 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Max Elephant
abilities.text: Summon an elephant that floods a 6-block area with water. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rabbit Escape
abilities.text: A swarm of shadow rabbits hides you: enemies lose their target and you're invisible for 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Great Serpent
abilities.text: Summon a serpent that rises under the enemy you look at and holds it for 2 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Garden
abilities.text: Fill a 5-block area with shadow for 10 s; you can sink and resurface anywhere in it. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Round Deer
abilities.text: Summon a deer that heals you and allies 1 a second for 6 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Piercing Ox
abilities.text: Summon an ox that charges forward 12 blocks, breaking soft blocks. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Stash
abilities.text: Store a whole stack in your shadow; take it out later anywhere. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Chimera Shadow
abilities.text: Merge your dogs and nue for 10 s: you gain Speed II and Strength I. 5 min cooldown.

name: Puppet Shell
desc: A frail body that can't leave its bed, piloting a cursed puppet across the world. Every limb is a gun, a blade or a tool.
traits: Your body is the puppet: +6 armour, immune to poison and drowning
Use iron and redstone to heal (2 per item)
Can't eat for food (hunger is always full, saturation never rises): no food buffs

abilities.name: Remote Eye
abilities.text: Send a tiny drone up to 32 blocks to scout for 15 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Thrusters
abilities.text: Fly upward for 3 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Built-in Tools
abilities.text: Your arm becomes any tool (pickaxe, axe, shovel) of iron grade for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Repair
abilities.text: Repair the item in your hand by 20% with iron. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Signal Relay
abilities.text: Talk to any player in the same world through chat, even far away, and see their direction for 30 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Ultra Cannon
abilities.text: Charge 2 s and fire a beam 16 blocks for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Magnet Arm
abilities.text: Pull an item or block entity to you from 16 blocks. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spare Parts
abilities.text: Turn iron in your inventory into armour repair: fix all worn armour by 10%. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Searchlight
abilities.text: A beam of light from your eyes lights the way 24 blocks for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Rocket Jump
abilities.text: Blast up 8 blocks, slow fall after. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Defence Mode
abilities.text: Resistance II for 6 s but you can't move. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sword Arm
abilities.text: Your arm becomes a blade for 20 s: +4 damage and sweeping hits. 2 min cooldown.

name: Vow-Sworn
desc: Folk who live by binding vows. They give something up and get more back. They are the most dangerous when they make a promise.
traits: Each day you choose a vow at dawn: 10% more damage, or 10% less damage taken
Ring of Promises and vow items work twice as strongly
Breaking a vow (dying) costs 10% of your experience

abilities.name: Sworn Restriction
abilities.text: For 30 s, you can't sprint, but your spells deal 30% more. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reveal Technique
abilities.text: Tell the mob you're fighting your technique: your next 3 attacks deal 20% more. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pact
abilities.text: Bind an ally: while within 16 blocks of each other, both heal 1 every 5 s for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Oath of Return
abilities.text: Promise to come back: mark a spot, and after you die you respawn there once within 30 minutes. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Give and Take
abilities.text: Spend 4 health to refill 30% mana, or 30% mana to heal 4. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Simple Domain
abilities.text: For 6 s, enemies within 3 blocks that you haven't hit yet are struck back when they swing. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Vow of Silence
abilities.text: You can't chat for 2 minutes, but you're invisible to mobs while sneaking. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Debt
abilities.text: Borrow 6 health now; lose 8 over the next minute. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Witnessed Vow
abilities.text: Make a vow with an ally: both get 10% more damage while within 8 blocks for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Overtime
abilities.text: After sunset, your next 2 minutes give 15% more damage and speed. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Price of Knowledge
abilities.text: Pay 5 levels to see every structure within 128 blocks on your map. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hollow Wicker Basket
abilities.text: For 5 s, domains, sure-hit attacks and spells can't affect you, but you can't move. 3 min cooldown.

name: Angelborn
desc: Hosts of a being that hunts techniques. Their light unmakes cursed energy, and they have little patience for anything unholy.
traits: Undead and cursed spirits take 15% more damage from you
Wings: slow falling while sneaking
Your own Cursed Fate techniques cost 25% more

abilities.name: Jacob's Ladder
abilities.text: A beam of light from the sky erases every active effect on the target, good or bad. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wings
abilities.text: Fly freely for 6 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Halo of Truth
abilities.text: Reveal every invisible or disguised creature within 24 blocks for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Cure an ally of every curse and harmful effect, healing 4. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sanctum
abilities.text: Mark a 6-block area for 2 minutes where domains and barriers can't open. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Technique Erasure
abilities.text: The enemy you look at can't cast spells or techniques for 5 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Light of Heaven
abilities.text: Light a 12-block area for 2 minutes and burn undead slowly in it. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Feather Shield
abilities.text: Absorb the next spell that hits you within 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Choir
abilities.text: Allies within 10 blocks get Regeneration I and Resistance I for 8 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Judgement Sight
abilities.text: See everything that has hurt you or an ally in the last minute, glowing, for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Ascend
abilities.text: Rise 12 blocks straight up and glide down. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Holy Lance
abilities.text: Throw a lance of light that deals 8, doubled against undead and curses. 45 s cooldown.

name: Projection Heir
desc: Zen'in heirs who split each second into 24 frames and move through them. Fast beyond reason, and arrogant to match.
traits: +20% movement speed
Sprinting costs no extra hunger
Being stunned or knocked down lasts 50% longer

abilities.name: Frame Dash
abilities.text: Dash 12 blocks in a straight line in an instant. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: 24 Frames
abilities.text: For 8 s, you move 50% faster and climb blocks without jumping. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Afterimage
abilities.text: Leave an afterimage that mobs attack for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.text: The longer you sprint, the faster you go: up to +30% after 10 s. Passive while sprinting, 60 s cooldown after stopping.

abilities.name: Quick Hands
abilities.text: Swap items, eat and drink twice as fast for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Speed Read
abilities.text: Your next 5 block breaks are instant. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Water Run
abilities.text: Run across water for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Clan Pride
abilities.text: Villagers trade with you at 10% less for 5 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Escape Plan
abilities.text: When you drop below 4 health, gain Speed III for 3 s (once every 2 minutes).

abilities.name: Mapped Route
abilities.text: Mark a path while sprinting; it glows for 5 minutes. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Frame Lock
abilities.text: The enemy you hit next is frozen in a frame for 1 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Supersonic Strike
abilities.text: Dash through every enemy in a 10-block line, 6 damage each. 90 s cooldown.

name: Speech-Bound
source: Toge Inumaki and the Inumaki clan
desc: Heirs of Cursed Speech, whose words become commands. They talk only in rice-ball fillings so they don't hurt anyone by accident.
traits: Your commands hit harder when your throat is healthy: honey or cough syrup restores 20% mana
Mobs can hear your voice through walls (they come investigate sooner)
Each command used gives you a sore throat: 1 damage

abilities.name: Stop
abilities.text: Mobs within 8 blocks freeze in place for 2 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Don't Move
abilities.text: The mob you look at is rooted for 4 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.text: Passive or neutral mobs within 8 blocks fall asleep for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Come Here
abilities.text: The animal or ally you look at walks straight to you. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Get Lost
abilities.text: Hostile mobs within 10 blocks walk away from you for 4 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Be Quiet
abilities.text: Sculk sensors, wardens and alarm mobs don't hear anything within 8 blocks for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Run
abilities.text: You and allies within 8 blocks get Speed II for 6 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Megaphone
abilities.text: Your next command reaches twice as far. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Onigiri Code
abilities.text: Send a coded message to any player in the world; only they can read it. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Throat Remedy
abilities.text: Heal your throat: your next 3 commands cost no health. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Explode
abilities.text: The mob you look at takes 8 damage from a burst inside it. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Twist
abilities.text: The enemy you look at takes 5 damage and Weakness II for 5 s. 60 s cooldown.

name: Curse-Bonded
desc: Someone a loving curse refused to leave. It follows them everywhere, saves them from death, and terrifies everyone else.
traits: A spirit watches over you: once every 20 minutes, a fatal hit is blocked
Copy: 10% chance to learn the next spell that hits you for 60 s
Mobs within 4 blocks feel dread: animals won't breed near you

abilities.name: Manifest
abilities.text: The spirit appears and carries you 10 blocks forward. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spirit Storage
abilities.text: Store up to 27 items in the spirit. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Love Shield
abilities.text: The spirit takes the next hit for you within 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Copy Technique
abilities.text: Copy the last spell an enemy cast near you and cast it once. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Healing Output
abilities.text: Heal yourself or an ally you look at for 8. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spirit Watch
abilities.text: The spirit stands guard where you leave it for 2 minutes, alerting you to mobs. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Ring of Promises
abilities.text: Wearing a ring, your spells cost 15% less for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hold Tight
abilities.text: The spirit grabs a falling ally or you, preventing fall damage for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Gentle Fear
abilities.text: Hostile mobs below 20 health won't target you for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Promise Kept
abilities.text: Mark an ally; if they die within 10 minutes, the spirit drags them back with 4 health. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rika's Grip
abilities.text: The spirit crushes the enemy you look at for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pure Love Beam
abilities.text: A beam of cursed energy, 20 blocks long, 12 damage. 5 min cooldown.

name: Spirit Tamer
source: Suguru Geto and Cursed Spirit Manipulation
desc: Sorcerers who swallow defeated curses and call them back as servants. The taste is foul; the army is worth it.
traits: Cursed Fate cursed spirits you kill drop a cursed orb you can absorb
Mobs you summon last 25% longer
Eating anything after absorbing a curse gives Nausea for 3 s

abilities.name: Absorb Curse
abilities.text: Absorb a weakened cursed spirit or hostile mob (below 25% health) to summon later. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Release
abilities.text: Summon your strongest absorbed mob as an ally for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Flying Curse
abilities.text: Summon a flying curse that carries you for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Scout Curse
abilities.text: Release a small curse that wanders 32 blocks and shows you what it sees for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Swarm
abilities.text: Summon 4 weak curses that distract mobs for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Pack Mule Curse
abilities.text: Summon a curse that carries 27 items for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Dig Curse
abilities.text: Summon a curse that tunnels a 2x1 passage 16 blocks forward. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hold Curse
abilities.text: Store a block-sized structure (up to 3x3x3) in a curse and place it later. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Curse Bargain
abilities.text: Release an absorbed curse to gain 30% mana. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Leader's Presence
abilities.text: Your summons get Speed I and Strength I for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Uzumaki
abilities.text: Release every absorbed curse at once as a spiral blast, 2 damage per curse stored. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rainbow Dragon
abilities.text: Summon a curse dragon that charges in a line for 10 damage. 3 min cooldown.

name: Transfigured
desc: Humans whose souls were reshaped by a curse and somehow survived. Their bodies are wrong in useful ways.
traits: Your body bends: you can crawl through 1-block gaps at full speed
Immune to poison and nausea
Healing potions heal 25% less

abilities.name: Stretch
abilities.text: Reach 3 blocks further for breaking and using blocks for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Extra Arms
abilities.text: Use a second tool or weapon at the same time for 20 s (offhand acts as a full hand). 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Wings of Flesh
abilities.text: Glide for 8 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Gills
abilities.text: Breathe underwater for 2 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Spring Legs
abilities.text: Jump 5 blocks high for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hard Shell
abilities.text: +4 armour for 30 s, but -10% speed. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Mouth Pocket
abilities.text: Store 9 items in a second mouth. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reshape Face
abilities.text: Look like a villager to mobs and illagers for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Sticky Palms
abilities.text: Climb walls for 10 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Regrow
abilities.text: Heal 6 health over 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Flesh Spike
abilities.text: A spike shoots out at the enemy in front, 6 damage. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Polymorphic Soul Isomer
abilities.text: Throw a transfigured body that bursts for 8 damage in 3 blocks. 2 min cooldown.

name: Lightning-Born
desc: Their cursed energy behaves like electricity. Metal sings near them, and their reflexes run at the speed of a spark.
traits: Immune to lightning damage
+10% attack speed
Water: touching it while charged gives you 1 damage

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.text: Store a charge: your next tool use or hit acts 50% faster. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spark Jump
abilities.text: Jump on a bolt 8 blocks forward. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Power Up
abilities.text: Power every redstone component within 6 blocks for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Static Sense
abilities.text: Feel every creature moving within 24 blocks for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Recharge
abilities.text: Restore 25% mana when struck by lightning, or 10% at once. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Magnetise
abilities.text: Pull every metal item within 12 blocks to you. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Light Up
abilities.text: Your body glows as a light source for 2 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Bolt Messenger
abilities.text: Send a lightning bolt to mark a spot for allies to see for 30 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reflex
abilities.text: For 5 s, dodges cost no stamina. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Thunder Call
abilities.text: Call a storm (thunder) over your area. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Electric Staff
abilities.text: Your next 3 hits chain lightning to one nearby enemy for 3 damage. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Mythical Beast Amber
abilities.text: Become living lightning for 10 s: Speed II, hits deal +4 lightning damage, then Weakness for 10 s. 10 min cooldown.

name: Heian Fiend
desc: Descended from the four-armed demon of the Heian era. Two faces, four arms, and an appetite for everything.
traits: Four arms: hold a second shield or tool (offhand works as main hand for tools)
A second face sees behind you: mobs sneaking up on you are revealed within 8 blocks
Villagers and golems are wary: golems start hostile

abilities.name: Second Mouth
abilities.text: A mouth on your stomach chants: your next spell casts instantly. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Four-Arm Work
abilities.text: Break blocks and craft twice as fast for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rear Gaze
abilities.text: See behind you (the second face) for 30 s: mobs behind you glow. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: King's Presence
abilities.text: Mobs weaker than you (below half your max health) won't approach for 30 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Gourmet
abilities.text: Eat anything (rotten, raw, cursed) safely for 5 minutes, gaining 50% more food. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shrine
abilities.text: Place a shrine for 5 minutes: mobs can't spawn within 12 blocks. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fire Arrow Craft
abilities.text: Make 16 flame arrows from 16 arrows and coal. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Contempt
abilities.text: Ignore all slowness and weakness for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Two Voices
abilities.text: Talk to two players at once from any distance for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Feast Sense
abilities.text: Smell every cooked food and animal within 32 blocks for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Dismantle
abilities.text: An invisible slash in a 6-block line, 7 damage. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: The enemy you hit next takes extra damage scaling with its max health (8%). 60 s cooldown.

name: Gambler
source: Kinji Hakari and Idle Death Gamble
desc: Sorcerers whose power runs on luck. When the reels line up they're unstoppable; when they don't, they keep spinning.
traits: Luck +1
Every hour you can spin once: a random good effect for 5 minutes
Bad luck streaks: 5% of the time, a spin gives a harmful effect instead

abilities.name: Spin the Reels
abilities.text: Roll a random buff (Speed, Strength, Regeneration, Haste or Luck II) for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Jackpot
abilities.text: 1 in 4 chance: for 30 s, heal to full and regenerate any damage taken instantly. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Double or Nothing
abilities.text: Bet an item stack: 50% chance to double it, 50% to lose it. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lucky Dig
abilities.text: Your next 20 ores have a 30% chance of double drops. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Pachinko Balls
abilities.text: Drop a handful of balls that make mobs slip and fall for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hot Streak
abilities.text: Each kill within 60 s raises your damage by 5%, up to 25%. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Coin Flip
abilities.text: Heads: teleport 8 blocks back. Tails: teleport 8 blocks forward. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reroll
abilities.text: Reset the cooldown of one other race ability. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fever Mode
abilities.text: For 20 s, every ability you use has a 50% chance not to go on cooldown. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: House Edge
abilities.text: Villager trades have a 25% chance to give double results for 5 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rough Energy
abilities.text: Fire a spray of rough cursed energy that knocks back for 4 damage. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lucky Shot
abilities.text: Your next attack is a guaranteed critical with 50% more damage. 45 s cooldown.

name: Straw Doll Witch
desc: Witches who use straw dolls and nails to hurt from afar. Anything that has left a piece of itself behind can be struck.
traits: Collect a piece of any mob you hit (its resonance) for 60 s
Hammers and nails count as weapons (+2 damage with a hammer)
Can't use bows or crossbows well (draw 25% slower)

abilities.name: Resonance
abilities.text: Strike a doll to hurt a mob you have resonance with, anywhere within 64 blocks, for 4. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nail Ladder
abilities.text: Hammer nails into a wall to make a 8-block climbable ladder for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pin Down
abilities.text: Nail a dropped item or door in place so nothing can take or open it for 5 minutes. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.text: Nails you've fired explode for 3 damage each when you trigger them. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Doll Decoy
abilities.text: Leave a straw doll that mobs attack for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Effigy Ward
abilities.text: A doll takes the next harmful effect put on you within 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Find Owner
abilities.text: Hold an item a creature dropped: point to that creature for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fix It
abilities.text: Nail broken blocks back: repair cracked or broken doors, trapdoors and fences within 6. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shared Pain
abilities.text: For 10 s, half of the damage you take is sent to a mob you have resonance with. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Strawman
abilities.text: Make a scarecrow that keeps crows and phantoms away from 16 blocks for 10 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Nail Shot
abilities.text: Hammer 3 nails at the target, 3 damage each. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Flash Nail
abilities.text: Your next nail deals 3x damage. 2 min cooldown.

name: Crow Caller
desc: Mercenary sorcerers who see through the eyes of crows. They always know where the money is.
traits: Crows and parrots are friendly and follow you
Emeralds drop 10% more often from mobs
Water birds and chickens are scared of you

abilities.name: Bird's Eye
abilities.text: See through a crow circling above you for 15 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Scout Crow
abilities.text: Send a crow 64 blocks ahead; it reports mobs, villages and chests. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Crow Courier
abilities.text: Send an item to any player in the same world by crow. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Murder
abilities.text: Release 6 crows that distract mobs for 6 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Bounty Sense
abilities.text: See every mob worth a reward (bosses, rare mobs) within 128 blocks for 10 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fee
abilities.text: Charge a villager: get 2 emeralds once per villager per day. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Glide on Wings
abilities.text: Crows carry you down slowly for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Crow's Hoard
abilities.text: Crows bring you a random shiny item (nugget, gem or coin). 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Night Patrol
abilities.text: Crows circle your bed and wake you if mobs come within 16 blocks while you sleep. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Contract
abilities.text: Hire a crow to watch a chest: you're told when it's opened, for 30 minutes. 30 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Bird Strike
abilities.text: A crow dives at full speed into the target for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Peck
abilities.text: Crows peck the enemy you look at for 1 damage a second for 6 s. 45 s cooldown.

name: Mahoraga-Blooded
source: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
desc: Distant kin of the shikigami that adapts to anything. A wheel turns above their heads, and nothing hurts them the same way twice.
traits: Adaptation: each time a damage type hurts you, you take 5% less from it (up to 30%) until you rest
The wheel above your head is visible to everyone
Healing from others is 25% weaker

abilities.name: Turn the Wheel
abilities.text: Instantly adapt fully (30%) to the last damage type that hit you, for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Terrain
abilities.text: Adapt to the ground: no slowdown from snow, soul sand, mud or cobwebs for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Air
abilities.text: Breathe in water, lava smoke and void air for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Cold
abilities.text: Immune to freezing and cold for 5 minutes. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Heat
abilities.text: Immune to fire and lava for 6 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Hunger
abilities.text: Hunger doesn't drop for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Dark
abilities.text: Night vision for 3 minutes. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Height
abilities.text: No fall damage for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapt to Poison
abilities.text: Immune to poison and wither for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Reset Wheel
abilities.text: Clear your adaptation and heal 6. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Sword of Extermination
abilities.text: Your next hit deals double damage to undead and curses. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Adapted Strike
abilities.text: Your hits deal 25% more to the last creature that hurt you, for 20 s. 90 s cooldown.

name: Barrier Monk
source: Master Tengen and the barrier technique
desc: Barrier keepers in Tengen's line who wall off the world. They protect, hide and seal, and they never truly leave a place they've warded.
traits: Your placed barriers last 25% longer
Hostile mobs can't spawn within 8 blocks of your bed or respawn point
Leaving a barrier you made gives you Slowness I for 3 s

abilities.name: Curtain
abilities.text: Drop a curtain over a 12-block area for 2 minutes: people outside can't see in, mobs inside don't flee. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Ward Door
abilities.text: Seal a door so only you and allies can open it, for 20 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Barrier Wall
abilities.text: Raise a see-through wall 5 wide, 3 tall for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Safe Room
abilities.text: Mark a room: you're told when anything enters it, for 30 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Bubble
abilities.text: A small barrier around you blocks projectiles for 6 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Fold Space
abilities.text: Link two marked spots within 64 blocks; walk from one to the other for 60 s. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Seal
abilities.text: Seal a spawner or chest so nothing comes out for 10 minutes. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Mobile Barrier
abilities.text: Allies within 6 take 10% less damage for 20 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Barrier Floor
abilities.text: Create a 5x5 floor in the air under you for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sense the Ward
abilities.text: See every barrier, domain and spell zone within 48 blocks for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cage
abilities.text: Trap the enemy you look at in a barrier for 3 s: it can't move or attack. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.text: A barrier collapses on enemies within 4 blocks for 6 damage. 60 s cooldown.
